name: Tokyo Electron Limited
guidance_fy: FY2027 (ending Mar 2027): Company guided H1 FY2027 net sales JPY 1,570B (+33% YoY) and operating income JPY 431B (+42.2% YoY), H1 op margin 27.5%. Long-term targets: net sales >= JPY 3 trillion and ROE >= 35%. Full-year FY2027 net income/EPS not separately guided at Q4 briefing. PROYECCION.
notes: PRICE: JPY 75,360 close 19-Jun-2026 (Yahoo/StockAnalysis); intraday ~77,800 seen later. Stock at/near 52-week AND all-time high (52w range 19,870-77,600; +224% over 12 months) on record FY2026 results and strong FY2027 guidance -> drop_classification=not_depressed (NOT depressed; momentum stock). MARKET CAP: JPY ~34.3T at 75,360; converted at USD/JPY ~155 => ~$221B (StockAnalysis showed JPY 35.39T at higher intraday price). FY2026 (ended Mar-2026): record net sales JPY 2,443.5B (+0.5% YoY), operating income JPY 624.9B (op margin ~25.6%), net income JPY 574.4B (+5.6%), EPS JPY 1,254.57, gross margin 45.3%, record FCF JPY 433.2B (FCF margin ~17.7%), ROE 29.3%, ROIC 30.5%. Announced 30-Apr-2026. Q4 FY2026 net sales JPY 711.8B (+28.9% QoQ), OP JPY 205.6B, gross margin 46.8%, EPS JPY 468.67 (beat).
